name: WBI Grasslands Pipeline
researcher_notes: EIA natural gas pipeline projects release of August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 316: project WB Grasslands Project I, operator Williston Basin Interstate PL, type New Pipeline, completed December 2003, states WY, MT and ND, cost 78.99 million dollars, 253 miles, 80 MMcf/d added, diameters 8 and 16 inches, FERC docket CP02-37. This is one origin only. A FERC order was not found because web search was unavailable in this pass; pair with the FERC CP02-37 order when cheap. Not in the tracker under any name: the only WBI rows are the system row P0281 (3364 mi, 1920 start), Valley Expansion P0367 and North Bakken Expansion. Later WB Grasslands Expansion II (2007, CP07-131) and III (2009, CP09-39) and Grasslands South Expansion (2023, CP23-35) are separate projects and not part of this row. Caution: the 253 mi is probably already inside P0281's system length, so a reviewer may prefer to treat this as a segment of P0281; flagged for a person to decide. Owner WBI Energy matches the existing entity. EIA gives the states as Wyoming, Montana and North Dakota; start and end set to the first and last states and the intermediate Montana not recorded. No route researched.
